notes: the second motor, mg90-c, through the same reduction as mg90-b's file in this folder, whose notes define every key; capture-1 is its ladder at 3.7, 5.0 and 7.4 V, 15 to 60 %, three repeats, in state A, the motor as delivered, so ke_by_level and open_zero_counts_by_level carry three levels and cycles carries the 3.7 V rows; meter_by_point and high_by_duty are meter-1 and high-1, 3 s spins with the DMM in series, in state C, after the run over the rated voltage and half a day at rest; reading_term_by_duty is stitched as mg90-b's, meter-1's point at 20, 30 and 40 % and high-1's at 60, 80 and 100 %, per volt and taken as the same on every rail, so i_spin_meter_a in the 3.7 V cycles carries it too; the Ke bounds follow mg90-b's recipe with the rail split from the 5.0 and 7.4 V pairs; direction_split_by_run and coast_decel_split_by_run_pct read capture-1 in state A and swapped-1's blocks in state C; the motor has no spinning run, so spinning_by_point, between_window_zero_counts, loop_l_ramp_mh and i_spin_meter_rl_bias_ma are not carried
